preconditions.description: The input string s has length between 1 and 200 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Every character in s is a lowercase English letter.
The integer n is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is the count of distinct palindromes obtainable by inserting exactly n lowercase letters into s, modulo 10007, printed as a string.

postconditions.expression: count_palindromes == sum(1 for p in all_possible_palindromes if is_palindrome(p) and can_form_from_s(p, s, n))
postconditions.description: The count represents the number of distinct strings p that are palindromes, can be formed by inserting exactly n characters into s, and are counted modulo 10007.
